description: This file defines a servlet 'ViewEnquiry' that handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve a list of enquiries from the database using 'EnquiryDBUtil' and forwards the data to the JSP page 'EnqDash.jsp' for display.

classes.name: ViewEnquiry
classes.description: A servlet class responsible for handling requests to view enquiries; it retrieves data from the database and forwards it to a JSP page.

methods.name: doGet
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests; retrieves all enquiries and forwards to the JSP view for display.
